column1: # ESP-IDF Partition Table — dual-OTA layout for 4MB flash.
# nvs keeps its standard offset/size so Wi-Fi creds (nvs.net80211)
# and the settings JSON blob survive partition swaps. otadata takes the old
# phy_init slot at 0xf000; phy_init shifts to 0x11000. Two 1.875M app slots leave
# ~25% headroom over the expected ~1.4M binary (Wi-Fi + mbedTLS + the "common"
# root cert bundle + httpd + the e-paper driver and font tables). The first OTA
# after a wired single-app flash lands in ota_0 via
# spare at the top of the 4MB part (room for a coredump partition later).
